review_paths.description: Paths agents may change by adding lines (CI workflows, test lists): a pull request that touches them is a draft that waits for a person and is never auto-merged. An edited or deleted line, or an added CI line that reaches secrets, is sent back to the Implementer. Same syntax as protected_paths; a path in both is protected. `.github/workflows/` is the only agent-configuration path this can open; skills, hooks and harness settings never open. Read from the default branch, so a branch can't widen it.

gates.description: Commands the pipeline runs itself (`agent-flow gates run`): the exit code is observed, not reported by a model. Read from the main checkout, so a branch can't edit the gate that judges it. Put a user switch in the command if it must run as another user (`sudo -u ci …`).

command.description: A string runs through the shell; an array is an argv with no shell.

cwd.description: Repo-relative directory, inside the checkout being judged.

os.description: Platforms the gate can run on. Elsewhere it is skipped and reported as skipped (never as a pass); CI on a listed platform judges it. Use for builds and tests that need a Linux toolchain or a POSIX filesystem.

on_stop.description: Also run this gate when an interactive Claude Code session tries to end its turn (needs `install --harness claude --stop-gate`). Keep these fast: lint, typecheck, unit tests.

deny_read.description: Paths or globs agents may not read (same syntax as protected_paths). Real env files (.env, .env.local, …) are always denied; a human overrides with AGENT_FLOW_ALLOW_SECRET_READ=1.

secret_scan.description: Secret-scanner settings. Known fakes (test fixtures, docs samples) belong here or behind an `agent-flow:allow-secret` comment, not behind --no-verify.

ignore_paths.description: Paths or globs whose contents are not scanned for secrets (same syntax as protected_paths).

lean.description: How hard the Implementer and Reviewer push for the smallest correct change. lite (default): reuse what the repo has, fix the root cause, leave one runnable check, mark deliberate shortcuts with a `lean:` comment, name a lazier alternative in the report. full: also climb the ladder strictly (nothing new if the repo, the standard library, the platform or an installed dependency does it) and block an avoidable new dependency. off: neither role is told. Never relaxes validation, security, accessibility or data-loss handling.

isolate_roles.description: Launch each role with --setting-sources project,local so a global plugin or hook on this machine can't add context to a role (it would change what the Reviewer judges and what QA runs). Off by default: it also drops the user's own Claude Code settings for roles.

qa_reuses_gates.description: Default true. When QA would run exactly the commands the gates just ran and all of them passed on this commit, the QA result is recorded from the gate logs instead of launching a QA role that would repeat the work (a gate has no re-run for flakiness; QA does). Set false to always launch QA.

harness_by_role.description: Run a role on a different harness than the orchestrator's, e.g. the Reviewer on another vendor so it doesn't share the Implementer's blind spots. The verdict still goes through the schema, the round cap and the audit chain.

max_stop_blocks.description: How many consecutive times the stop gate may hold a session back in one turn before it lets the turn end (and records stop_gate_exhausted).

max_cost_usd.description: Per-issue cost cap. Once an issue's role runs have cost this much, a new phase or round escalates to Needs Me (budget_exceeded). Only harnesses that report cost count.

models.description: Model IDs the orchestrator passes to each role's --model flag. Omit a key to use the harness default.

policy.description: Change-size and content rules checked by `classify --fail-on-policy` and the pre-commit hook.

deny_commands.description: Shell commands the guard refuses in every agent session (a human overrides with AGENT_FLOW_ALLOW_PROTECTED=1). Working copies may add to what the default branch committed, never remove.

presets.description: database: DROP/TRUNCATE through psql, mysql, sqlite3 and friends. infra: kubectl delete, terraform destroy, docker prune, helm uninstall, cloud CLI deletes.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression tested against each added line.
